sections.value: F276 R2 at b9f87dc PASS-WITH-NOTES 6940b2d closes B332-01. The same intent moves waiter -> SpawnHold::carry -> independent launch task; no await/decrement at transfer. Successful put_lifting_owner_close commits before explicit hold drop; early rejection and panic release the intent. Cancellation before the lock launched nothing and ends the waiter-owned guard. Stop timeout only abandons its wait, not the owner/intent; actual process exit before row persistence loses the in-memory brake. No failure leak found; a stuck retained owner can only spare. Preserved witness and prior causal control GREEN; M7 both RED with retired work, M8 both RED at intended pre/post-cancel missing-intent assertions. Merge is reviewed-main-only. MagicWand is now encoded: committed handler cancellation, lock-wait and panic regressions, not only map-accessor tests. Existing matched-count AFTER remains owed. Scratch restored/cleaned; receipts in session ae639be0/files.
